comment.body: This report concerns the old Screen Ruler default `Win+Shift+M`, which conflicted with Windows’ restore-minimized-windows shortcut. Current PowerToys source defaults Screen Ruler to `Win+Ctrl+Shift+M`, so it no longer claims `Win+Shift+M`; the broader conflict was also tracked in #20194. I suggest closing this historical issue as handled. If a current release still intercepts `Win+Shift+M` after Screen Ruler is assigned another shortcut, please file a fresh regression with the current version and settings export.

title: The key combination of the screen ruler utility causes problems with standard key combinations in Windows 10
